test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: All 32 students of a class are standing in a straight row facing north. Anand is 6th from the right end, while Meena is 14th from the left end. How many students stand between Anand and Meena?
solution:
Given:-

Total students standing in the row → 32

Position of Anand from the right end of the row → 6th

Position of Meena from the left end of the row → 14th

Sum of** **position of Anand from the right end of the row and position of Meena from the left end of the row → 6 + 14 = 20
